rationale: Both no-result runs had the highest utilisation (38-40%); every run at 21-30% finished feasible, so pin 22. Hold (~+0.1 ns), DRC and slew/cap never bound. Setup slack stayed +4-14 ns, so timing repair never engaged, yet tighter targets gave far lower T_eff (frac 0.48-0.58 -> 6.5-8.2 ns; 0.93-0.98 -> 10-11 ns): pin the tightest, 0.45, which is also nearest the real clock. The three best runs all used timing-driven, non-routability placement with post-GRT design repair. Post-GRT timing repair and moderate margins cost nothing at these targets but help the confirmation re-runs near 6.5 ns pass. Synthesis strategy, ABC buffering/sizing, RC model, density and repair percentages stay free for TPE.
